freeze_disclosure.result_visibility: Independent read-only audit workers reported preliminary primary pass-rate MAE results before this executor plan was committed.
freeze_disclosure.consequence: This is a reproducibility and methodology-correction audit, not a blinded prospective experiment. No algorithm, source, Origin, horizon, budget, primary baseline, primary MAE gate, or membership rule may be changed in response to those reported values.
freeze_disclosure.preexisting_specification: ALG-013, ALG-014, and THY-002S algorithms and primary Stage-C outcome requirements were frozen in their parent plans before any audit worker ran.

research_contract.target: Determine whether ALG-013, ALG-014, or THY-002S was substantively misclassified because a surrogate metric stopped execution before the inexpensive pass-rate MAE join to already-open public Agent outcomes.
research_contract.primary_outcome: For every held-out Agent configuration and rolling Origin, absolute selected-history pass rate minus future-cohort pass rate; aggregate configurations and Origins within repository, then repositories equally.
required_evidence: exact deterministic membership materialization from each frozen algorithm
H5 and H10 candidate, full-history, and candidate-minus-full pass-rate MAE
deterministic random calibration where the parent contract specifies it
two byte-identical raw executions and a compact digest-bound summary
insufficient_outcomes: Brier loss, ROC AUC, embedding centroid loss, or difficulty-coordinate loss presented as pass-rate MAE
a pooled Task, Origin, or Agent average that lets long repositories dominate
a favorable random percentile without beating full history
altering a frozen Selector or gate after observing this opened panel
claiming this development-panel audit is independent confirmation
claiming an under-specified secondary Stage-C diagnostic was uniquely frozen

rolling_origin.repository_sets: Reuse exact H5 wide/deep and H10 common/deep sets from selector-plan.json.
rolling_origin.aggregation: held-out configuration equally, Origins within repository equally, repositories equally

ALG-013.materialization: For each Origin and held-out configuration, use the other active RCP directions, OLS next-block centroid forecast, and the preexisting greedy mean-match plus at most 20 best strictly improving swaps.
ALG-013.optimizer_provenance: Same semantics as select_embedding_mean_match, committed before the ALG-013 parent plan; strict improvement tolerance 1e-15.
controls: ordinary recency as a non-gating diagnostic
ALG-013.primary_h5_gate: difference <= -0.010, at least 10/13 repositories favorable, every leave-one-repository-out favorable, and deep favorable
ALG-013.primary_h10_gate: difference below zero, at least 8/11 repositories favorable, and deep favorable

ALG-014.materialization: For each held-out configuration, construct integer solved count from the other 35 configurations, run the frozen earlier-Origin expert and one-pseudo-Task prior forecast, then exact bounded composition matching.
ALG-014.tie_rule: Minimize absolute forecast distance; ties use lexicographically smallest count vector, then newest projected created_at and instance_id within each solved-count cell.
ALG-014.primary_h5_gate: difference <= -0.010, at least 10/13 repositories favorable, every leave-one-repository-out favorable, and deep favorable
ALG-014.primary_h10_gate: difference below zero, at least 8/11 repositories favorable, and deep favorable

THY-002S.materialization: Reuse the exact parent candidate, stationary, recency, history, H5 future, and H10 future Task identities; no Selection is rematerialized from Agent outcomes.
THY-002S.outcome_gate: Reuse downstream_outcome_contract from the parent plan without changing any threshold.
THY-002S.historical_status: The parent Stage A failure and retire_mapping decision remain true regardless of this audit.
THY-002S.provider_axis: Omitted because the parent downstream contract declares provider_count=3 but freezes no provider mapping; provider is descriptive and non-gating.

ALG-013_and_ALG-014.status: implementation-specific diagnostic, not a uniquely reconstructed original gate
ALG-013_and_ALG-014.coupling: Use one equal-budget subset per Origin and draw across all 36 configurations, via the existing Multi-SWE shared-subset implementation.

THY-002S.status: fully frozen by the parent downstream contract
THY-002S.coupling: One RNG stream; Origins sorted by repository casefold then Origin ID; same subset reused for all configurations and both horizons.

ALG-013: leave-model, leave-harness, leave-language, and double-holdout rematerialization
under_specified_original_stage_c_items.handling: Report primary MAE and deterministic controls. Never fill these gaps silently or claim a complete unique replay of the original Stage C.

resource_boundary.allowed_compute: local CPU with ignored frozen artifacts and already-open committed public outcomes

claim_boundary: This audit can show whether the proxy stop changed the substantive development-panel conclusion. It cannot retroactively pass a failed parent gate, nominate a Selector from an under-specified Stage C, establish prospective validity, authorize sealed holdout access, or create a Runner default.
